picker.noBrand: Select a brand to see its API keys.

list.name: Name
list.revokeConfirmDescription: Systems using this key stop getting recommendations within a minute. This can’t be undone.
list.deleteConfirmDescription: The key and its record are removed permanently. This can’t be undone.
list.createDescription: Name the key after the system that will use it.
list.expiresInDaysHint: 0 means the key never expires. Otherwise 1 to 3,650 days.
list.createdDescription: Store it in the calling system’s configuration or secret store.
list.createdWarning: Copy the key now. It can’t be shown again; if it’s lost, revoke it and create a new one.
list.channelHint: The ordering app that uses this key. The key serves this channel only.
list.noChannels: This brand has no active channel. Switch one on in the brand's Channels tab first.
